The scripts provide repository checks and regression tests. A failed tool invocation must not become an empty successful result. Check that negative controls reach the intended failure, and that snapshot collection failure stops comparison.

Use scripts/validate qml for isolated runtime validation. Never suggest qs -c vshell, qs -p quickshell/vshell, or pkill quickshell. A second shell can strand lock surfaces and black out the live desktop. Other Quickshell applications share the session. The isolated runtime smoke is scripts/qml-smoke.sh --nested.
